title: Estimates of the time geology had to work with, in years
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. Buffon's age of the earth from cooling globes, 1779: 74,832 years. Darwin's time for the erosion of the Weald alone, 1859: about 306 million years. William Thomson's age of the earth's crust from its cooling, 1862: 98 million years, within limits of 20 and 400 million. Clair Patterson's age of the earth from meteorite lead, 1956: 4.55 billion years.
heading: TIME FOR GEOLOGY · YEARS (LOG SCALE)

source.container: Drawn for kloom from Darwin's On the Origin of Species (1859), Thomson's "On the Secular Cooling of the Earth" (1862) and Wikipedia's Age of Earth for Buffon and Patterson
